I will build a professional Instagram Growth Simulator dashboard. Since actual "fake" views/likes require access to private Instagram APIs or paid third-party services (which cannot be embedded in a static frontend), this app implements a **Simulation Engine**. I will build a professional **Social Growth Engine** web application. 

Because Instagram does not provide a "free" way to increase likes/views via their official API (which requires strict app review), this app is designed as a **Service Wrapper**. It includes a fully functional simulation mode by default, and a dedicated **API Configuration panel** where you can plug in keys from third-party SMM (Social Media Marketing) panels like *SMMRush* or *JAPAL*, which are the industry standard for these services.
